title: gbrain skill resolver: turn input (schema_version 1)
description: One user turn for `gbrain skills resolve --input-json -` or resolveSkills(). Unknown fields are refused. Within v1, changes are additive only. Guide: docs/guides/skill-resolver.md.

message.description: The user message. Capped at 8192 UTF-8 bytes (cut at a character boundary). Never echoed in the block.

previous_user_message.description: The user's previous message. Ranked only when the current message matches no catalog word (a short follow-up such as "do it again"); a skill named only there is not treated as named.

session_id.description: The harness session id (1-256 visible ASCII characters). With it, suggestions are not repeated within the session and the session token budget applies.

harness.description: Picks the load line, and whether suggestion lines carry the SKILL.md path (codex, openclaw, pi, cursor).

exclude.description: Skill ids to leave out (for example the ones already loaded).

shadow.description: Compute the block without injecting it; state goes to a separate shadow namespace.

expected_catalog_hash.description: Refuse with skill_catalog_mismatch unless the catalog hash matches.

min_match_strength.description: The weakest match_strength to suggest (strongest first: named, name, triggers, routing, description, body). Weaker matches are dropped before the cut to top_k, so stronger ones still fill the block: it filters candidates and never empties the block. Omit it to keep every match.

top_gate.description: Empty the block (block_reason weak_top_match) when the best skill the block would show (after exclude, min_match_strength, session dedupe and pacing) has a score that, divided by its catalog's maximum idf, ln(1 + (n - 0.5) / 1.5) for n skills, is below this; with merged catalogs, the highest of those candidates. A skill named in the turn bypasses it. Omit it or pass 0 to keep the gate off (the default).

reset_session.description: The session was compacted: start its dedupe and budget again.
